1.english_reference: And an angel of the LORD came up from Gilgal to Bochim

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֧עַל מַלְאַךְ יְהוָ֛ה מִן הַ גִּלְגָּ֖ל אֶל הַ בֹּכִ֑ים

traditions.VUL: Ascendítque ángelus Dómini de Gálgalis ad Locum fléntium ,
traditions.KJV: And an angel of the LORD came up from Gilgal to Bochim ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπὶ Βαιθὴλ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ἰσραήλ ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּאמֶר֩

1.english_reference: I made you to go up out of Egypt

traditions.KJV: I made you to go up out of Egypt ,

traditions.KJV: and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers ;

1.english_reference: and I said , I will never break my covenant with you

traditions.KJV: and I said , I will never break my covenant with you .

2.english_reference: And ye shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land

traditions.VUL: ita dumtáxat ut non ferirétis fœdus cum habitatóribus terræ huius ,
traditions.KJV: And ye shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land ;

traditions.LXX: οὐδὲ τοῖς θεοῖς αὐτῶν προσκυνήσετε , ἀλλὰ τὰ γλυπτὰ αὐτῶν συντρίψετε ,

traditions.KJV: ye shall throw down their altars :

2.english_reference: but ye have not obeyed my voice

traditions.KJV: why have ye done this ?

3.english_reference: Wherefore I also said , I will not drive them out from before you

traditions.KJV: Wherefore I also said , I will not drive them out from before you ;

3.english_reference: but they shall be [ as thorns ] in your sides

traditions.WLC: וְ הָי֤וּ לָ כֶם֙ לְ צִדִּ֔ים

traditions.KJV: but they shall be [ as thorns ] in your sides ,

3.english_reference: and their gods shall be a snare unto you

traditions.KJV: and their gods shall be a snare unto you .

traditions.KJV: that the people lifted up their voice , and wept .

5.english_reference: And they called the name of that place Bochim

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּקְרְא֛וּ שֵֽׁם הַ מָּק֥וֹם הַ ה֖וּא בֹּכִ֑ים

traditions.VUL: Et vocátum est nomen loci illíus , Locus fléntium , sive lacrymárum :
traditions.KJV: And they called the name of that place Bochim :

traditions.KJV: and they sacrificed there unto the LORD .

6.english_reference: And when Joshua had let the people go

traditions.KJV: And when Joshua had let the people go ,

6.english_reference: the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land

traditions.KJV: the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land .

traditions.KJV: and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua ,

traditions.KJV: And Joshua the son of Nun , the servant of the LORD , died , [ being ]

traditions.KJV: an hundred and ten years old .

traditions.KJV: And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers :

traditions.KJV: and there arose another generation after them ,

traditions.KJV: of the gods of the people that [ were ] round about them ,

traditions.KJV: and bowed themselves unto them ,

traditions.KJV: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel ,

traditions.KJV: Whithersoever they went out ,
